<!-- Generated by `ims gen docs` from internal/authz/catalog.go. Do not edit: run `make docs-gen`. -->

83 permissions in 18 groups. Super-Admin bypasses every check. A tenant **Admin** holds the
tenant-level permissions; the **Developer** role holds the dashboard ones. Add a permission to
`internal/authz/catalog.go`, then run `ims permission:sync`.

## role

| Permission | Description | Seeded roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `role.view` | Can view role details | Admin |
| `role.view.all` | Can view all roles | Admin |
| `role.create` | Can create new roles | Admin |
| `role.internal.create` | Can create new internal roles | system |
| `role.update` | Can modify existing roles | Admin |
| `role.internal.update` | Can modify existing internal roles | system |
| `role.delete` | Can delete roles | Admin |

## user

| Permission | Description | Seeded roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user.view` | Can view user details | Admin |
| `user.view.all` | Can view all users | Admin |
| `user.create` | Can create new users | Admin |
| `user.internal.create` | Can create new users | system |
| `user.update` | Can modify existing users | Admin |
| `user.internal.update` | Can modify existing users | system |
| `user.two_factor.reset` | Can turn off a user's two-factor authentication (lost phone or mailbox) | Admin |
| `user.delete` | Can delete users | Admin |
| `user.internal.delete` | Can delete users across tenants | system |
| `user.role.assign` | Can Assign role to users | Admin |
| `user.internal.role.assign` | Can assign roles to users across tenants | system |
| `user.export` | Can export all users | Admin |
| `user.import` | Can import users | Admin |
| `user.internal.export` | Can export internal users | system |
| `user.erase` | Can erase a user's personal data (right to erasure) | Admin |
| `user.privacy_export` | Can export a user's personal data (right of access) | Admin |
| `user.internal.erase` | Can erase any user's personal data across tenants | system |
| `user.internal.privacy_export` | Can export any user's personal data across tenants | system |
| `user.internal.import` | Can import internal users | system |
| `user.tenant.switch` | Can switch active tenant | system |
| `user.branch.switch` | Can switch active branch | Admin |
| `user.impersonate` | Can act as another user (X-Acting-User) | Developer, system |
